title: 第80章 无耻那也是你青璇逼的第79章 象甲功突破青璇羞愤欲死
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
第80章无耻？那也是你青璇逼的！
惊人的柔软触感传来，陆成嘴角勾起一抹笑容。
他对这一拳的爆发力很自信！
若是和他同境界的筑基初期修士，恐怕在这一拳下，不死也要重伤！
青璇虽然一点事都没有，但在这一拳之下。
她的右.胸受到陆成的一击，开始极具有冲击力般地开始震颤起来。
与此同时，一股异样的酥麻感，席卷全身。
她的脸颊，蹭的一下红了起来。
再次被面前无耻之徒轻浮，并且还被对方作为训练的对手，她美目中露出怒色。
她欲要开口，陆成直接打断青璇，冷声戏谑道：“你什么你？我现在这副局面，还不是你造成的，既然你已经想好将我囚禁于此，你无法杀死我，只能等我老死，那就应该想过，在我没死之前，我们之间发生点什么都不足为奇，你此刻反应这么大做什么？”
说着，他又补了一句，道：“嗯~手感不错！”
陆成脸上露出意犹未尽的陶醉神情，瞪大双目，脸上带着笑意，直勾勾地盯着青璇，看她那脸颊如熟透了的红苹果般的反应。
她的耳根，更是红到了极致。
甚至此刻，她的反应比之前陆成持剑捅在她的胸.口反应还大！
青璇美目死死盯着陆成，羞愤道：“小子，你信不信，等你死后，我一定将你的尸体扔进茅厕中，遗臭万年！”
接着，她美目看向陆成的手，冰冷道：“我一定将你这只手砍下来，剁成粉碎！！”
青璇冰冷的誓言响彻宫殿，她美目愤怒地盯着陆成，俏脸上的红霞与这神情结合在一起。
倒是有一股别样的美感！
这是陆成从未见过的画面。
陡然间，陆成脑海中浮现林倾月的身影，她脸上总是浮现冰冷高贵的神色。

她从未笑过，但宛如一个冰美人般，深深地烙印在陆成的脑海中。
陆成从未见过林倾月冰冷的脸上展露出羞愤的绝美画面。
而此刻，他在青璇的神情中见到了。
愤怒的美目，覆着寒冰的脸颊，红透的耳根，又染上一抹红霞，看起来娇艳欲滴。
陆成心情极好，脸上依旧带着笑容。
陆成突然开口道：“你有没有听过一句话？”
青璇美目愤怒地盯着陆成：“？？？”
陆成微笑道：“活在当下！”
活在当下？
青璇美目微微一愣，自然瞬间明白了陆成的言外之意。
那就是陆成只享受现在，至于他死后，所发生的事情，又能如何？
青璇羞愤道：“你无耻！”
“那也是你逼的！”陆成脸挂笑容，人畜无害道。
青璇：“……”
下一秒，青璇的耳根和脸颊更红了。
陆成仿佛进入了某种享受的状态，不断化拳为掌。
一下一下轰在她的胸.口。
转眼间过去足足一刻钟后。
陆成意犹未尽地收掌，他看着双目欲要喷出火焰的青璇，淡淡一笑。
陆成冷笑道：“放我离开此地，我就不会再羞辱你，如何？”

“你做梦！”青璇羞愤冷声道。
陆成看向青璇，道：“好，很好，那你做好等待的准备吧，那就等我突破化神境，然后干死你！”
最后一句，陆成继续面带笑容说道。
青璇听到最后三个字，美目露出仿佛要吃人的愤怒光芒！
陆成径直来到地面上，开始打量着宫殿四周。
content_en:
Chapter 80 Shameless? That was also forced by you, Qingxuan!
The surprisingly soft touch came, and Lu Cheng's lips curved into a smile.
He is very confident in the explosive power of this punch!
If he were a monk in the early stage of foundation building at the same level as him, he would probably be seriously injured even if he was not dead under this punch!
Although Qingxuan was fine at all, she was under this punch.
Her right breast received a blow from Lu Cheng and began to tremble with great impact.
At the same time, a strange numbing feeling swept through his body.
Her cheeks suddenly turned red.
Once again, she was flirted with by the shameless man in front of her, and was even used as a training opponent. There was anger in her beautiful eyes.
When she was about to speak, Lu Cheng directly interrupted Qingxuan and joked coldly: "What are you doing? You are not the cause of my current situation. Since you have already thought about imprisoning me here, you can't kill me and can only wait for me to die of old age. Then you should have thought about it. Before I die, it is not surprising that something happened between us. Why are you reacting so much right now?"
As he spoke, he added another sentence and said, "Yeah~ It feels good!"
Lu Cheng's face showed an expression of unfulfilled intoxication, his eyes widened with a smile on his face, staring directly at Qingxuan, watching her reaction like a ripe red apple on her cheeks.
The roots of her ears were extremely red.
Even at this moment, her reaction was even greater than when Lu Cheng stabbed her chest with a sword!
Qing Xuan stared at Lu Cheng with her beautiful eyes, and said with shame and anger: "Boy, do you believe it or not, after you die, I will definitely throw your body into the toilet, and it will be stink for thousands of years!"
Then, she looked at Lu Cheng's hand with her beautiful eyes and said coldly: "I will definitely chop off your hand and chop it into pieces!!"
Qingxuan's cold oath resounded throughout the palace, her beautiful eyes stared at Lu Cheng angrily, and the red glow on her pretty face combined with this expression.
It does have a different kind of beauty!
This is a scene that Lu Cheng has never seen before.
Suddenly, the figure of Lin Qingyue appeared in Lu Cheng's mind, and she always had a cold and noble look on her face.
She never smiled, but like an ice beauty, she was deeply imprinted in Lu Cheng's mind.
Lu Cheng had never seen the beautiful scene of Lin Qingyue's cold face showing shame and anger.
At this moment, he saw it in Qingxuan's expression.
The angry beautiful eyes, the cheeks covered with ice, and the red ears are stained with a touch of red, making them look delicate and charming.
Lu Cheng was in a good mood and still had a smile on his face.
Lu Cheng suddenly said: "Have you ever heard a sentence?"
Qingxuan's beautiful eyes stared at Lu Cheng angrily: "???"
Lu Cheng smiled and said: "Live in the moment!"
Live in the moment?
Qingxuan's beautiful eyes were stunned for a moment, and she naturally immediately understood the implication of Lu Cheng's words.
That is, Lu Cheng only enjoys the present. As for what happens after his death, what will happen?
Qingxuan said with shame and anger: "You are shameless!"
"That's what you forced me to do!" Lu Cheng said with a smile on his face, harmless to humans and animals.
Qingxuan: "..."
The next second, Qingxuan's ears and cheeks turned redder.
Lu Cheng seemed to have entered a state of enjoyment, constantly turning his fists into palms.
Hitting her chest one after another.
A full quarter of an hour passed in the blink of an eye.
Lu Chengyi retracted his palm before he could finish it. He looked at Qingxuan, whose eyes were about to burst into flames, and smiled faintly.
Lu Cheng sneered and said, "Let me leave this place and I won't humiliate you again. How about that?"
"You're dreaming!" Qingxuan said coldly with shame and anger.
Lu Cheng looked at Qingxuan and said: "Okay, very good, then you should be prepared to wait. Then wait for me to break through to the God Transformation Realm, and then I will kill you!"
Lu Cheng continued to say the last sentence with a smile.
When Qingxuan heard the last three words, her beautiful eyes showed an angry light as if she wanted to eat people!
Lu Cheng went straight to the ground and began to look around the palace.
